params.body:
## What

The Transport tab under Instellingen, where a garage accepts the five transport conditions, now follows the garage's transport switch (the Gate `use-transport`, R S4-10.18), like the transport routes already do.

Fixes bevinding transportvoorwaarden-onbereikbaar-na-schakelaar.

## Why

StockCars (dealer 4) has `transport_enabled` on, but its users did not see the Transport tab or the Transport entry under Service. The tab asked the role right `setting_transport`, which no garage role grants; #863 only put the key `transport` in `Access::GATED`. `TransportConditions` requires all five conditions before a transport can be requested, so a garage with the switch could not reach what it had to accept.

## How

- `Access::GATED` gets `setting_transport => use-transport`; the rights a gated key grants are one constant (`GATED_RIGHTS`: view, add, edit, no delete).
- `LinkHelper::rights()` answers a gated key from its Gate, exactly as the Access middleware does; the role row is not asked. Nothing called `rights('transport.*')`, so this only changes the settings tab.
- `GarageRights::gatedMenus()` adds the keys of `Access::GATED` to the menus that carry an ability, so the rights dry run and the `module_rights` path (#880) list `setting_transport` as decided by its Gate and never by a module.
- `settings.update.transport` carries `can:use-transport`: a garage without the switch gets 403 and saves nothing.
- The tariffs on the same tab (margin, express percentage, handover report, base price per class) are one platform-wide table, not the garage's. They were behind `setting_transport.update`; now that right follows the switch, they are behind `isAdmin()` in the view and in `SettingsController::updateTransport`, matching R P2-8.3. A garage that posts them anyway changes nothing.

Business rules: R S4-10.18 says the conditions tab follows the same switch; R P2-8.4 says the tariffs are the administrator's.

## Tests

`TransportConditionsFollowTheSwitchTest` (6 tests): a role-5 garage user with the switch sees the entry and the tab and saves the five conditions; without the switch there is no tab and the save is refused (403); a role row on `setting_transport` does not open it without the switch; the administrator sees the tab with the tariffs, a garage does not and cannot change them; the rights model lists `setting_transport` as gated and never decides it; with the `module_rights` flag on, the result is the same. Reverting the fix makes all six fail.

Full suite locally, PHPStan clean, pint on the new file.
params.title: Transport conditions tab follows the garage's transport switch
